messages.subject: node tips being changed
parts:
Hi,
I am new to R and poppr, and this might sound like a non-relevant question so i apologize in advance.
I am trying to analyse SSR data from plants (37 samples from 5 populations). 

Genalex input file was created in excel and was saved as a .csv file.I have imported the data in R using read.genalex function, and prepared a UPGMA dendrogram using a.boot. Dendrogram is plotted, but with a small problem.

The problem with the dendrogram is that the node-tips have been labelled as Ind1, Ind2, Ind3.....Ind37 instead of the actual sample names that were present in the .csv file.
Interestingly, when i prepare the data as representing 1 population with all 37 individuals and then plot the dendrogram, node-tips are labelled with sample names and not Ind1, Ind2....

I tried to check individual names using indNames() and for some reason it was changed to Ind1, Ind2....for data with 5 populations, but returned proper sample names for data representing a single population.

I am confused, please help.

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] node tips being changed
parts:
Hello,

When read.genalex reads in a file, the sample names are checked to make sure that there are no duplicates. If there are duplicate names, they are replaced with generic names and the original names are saved in the other slot under the element "original_names". You can access them with other(myData)$original_names.

Given the pattern of the names being retained with more than one population, I suspect that when you look at the original names, you will find the population definitions, indicating that the original file was not structured in a way for poppr to recognize. Here's a short tutorial about what poppr expects the genalex format to look like: http://grunwaldlab.github.io/Population_Genetics_in_R/Data_Preparation.html

Hope that helps,
Zhian
